macros.name: cite
macros.doc: The citation command is similar to the one in standard LaTeX except that the prefix ⟨options⟩ is in key-value style. The ⟨options⟩ can be prefix, suffix, or one of the suffix locators like page or figure.

macros.name: citeauthor
macros.doc: This command prints the author name.

macros.name: citep
macros.doc: The \parencite and \citep command are aliases of \cite. They are added for compatibility with biblatex and natbib packages.

macros.name: cites
macros.doc: The \cites accepts multiple cite items in a single citation.

macros.name: citeyear
macros.doc: This command prints the publication year of the citation.

macros.name: citeyearpar
macros.doc: This command suppresses the author names in the citation. It is equivalent to \cite with suppress-author option enabled.

macros.name: fullcite
macros.doc: This command prints a full citation similar to the bibliographic entry.

macros.name: parencite
macros.doc: The \parencite and \citep command are aliases of \cite. They are added for compatibility with biblatex and natbib packages.
